title: Forest with a blue edge
description: A spacious forest field with a vivid blue right edge and narrow diffused lime transition.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE complete wide 16:9 text-free abstract brand background, ideally 1672 x 941 or higher with the same landscape ratio.
Primary request: deep forest green occupies roughly 70 percent of the composition, softly graded between #132B26 and #1E493E, with a diffused luminous sky-blue edge entering from the right and a very thin yellow-lime light transition along that blue edge. Keep the upper-left and broad center spacious and quiet for typography to be added separately. Forest must remain visibly green, not near-black. The blue is vivid and fresh and the lime is luminous: this must POP while staying sophisticated and soft.
Palette: #132B26 deep forest, #1E493E lighter forest, #007EBD sky, #168DDD bright blue, #D6FF62 lime; tiny #C2EDFF ice highlights only.
Style/medium: flat matte color-field art with seamless, softly irregular optical diffusion; very fine uniform analog film noise, only perceptible up close. All major edges are diffuse. Light drifts asymmetrically in from the right perimeter, not a centered spotlight.
Constraints: strictly nonrepresentational, flat picture plane.
